sentences.en: For my presentation today, I'm going to talk about the Céide Fields in the northwest of Ireland, one of the largest Neolithic sites in the world.
sentences.zh: 今天我要做的报告是关于爱尔兰西北部的凯德田野（Céide Fields），这是世界上规模最大的新石器时代遗址之一。

sentences.en: I recently visited this site and observed the work that is currently being done by a team of archaeologists there.
sentences.zh: 我最近参观了这一遗址，并观察了目前在那里开展工作的考古学家团队所进行的工作。

sentences.en: The site was first discovered in the 1930s by a local teacher, Patrick Caulfield.
sentences.zh: 该遗址最早于20世纪30年代由当地一名教师帕特里克·考尔菲尔德（Patrick Caulfield）发现。

sentences.en: He noticed that when local people were digging in the bog, they were constantly hitting against what seemed to be rows of stones.
sentences.zh: 他注意到，当地人在泥炭沼泽中挖掘时，不断碰到看似成排的石头。

sentences.en: He realised that these must be walls and that they must be thousands of years old for them to predate the bog which subsequently grew over them.
sentences.zh: 他意识到这些必定是墙体，而且其年代必定已有数千年之久，因为它们形成时间早于后来覆盖其上的泥炭沼泽。

sentences.en: He wrote to the National Museum in Dublin to ask them to investigate, but no one took him seriously.
sentences.zh: 他致信都柏林国家博物馆，请求他们前来调查，但无人认真对待他的发现。

sentences.en: It wasn't until 40 years later, when Patrick Caulfield's son Seamus, who had become an archaeologist by then, began to explore further.
sentences.zh: 直到40年之后，帕特里克·考尔菲尔德的儿子西默斯（Seamus）——当时已成长为一名考古学家——才开始进一步探索该遗址。

sentences.en: He inserted iron probes into the bog to map the formation of the stones, a traditional method which local people had always used for finding fuel buried in the bog for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 他将铁制探针插入泥炭沼泽中，以测绘石块的分布形态；这是一种传统方法，当地居民数千年来一直用它来寻找埋藏于沼泽中的燃料。

sentences.en: Carbon dating later proved that the site was over 5,000 years old and was the largest Neolithic site in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 后来的碳年代测定证实，该遗址已有5000多年历史，是爱尔兰境内规模最大的新石器时代遗址。

sentences.en: Thanks to the bog which covers the area, the remains of the settlement at Céide Fields, which is over 5,000 years old, are extremely well-preserved.
sentences.zh: 得益于覆盖该地区的泥炭沼泽，已有5000多年历史的凯德田野定居点遗迹保存得极为完好。

sentences.en: A bog is 90 percent water; its soil is so saturated that when the grasses and heathers that grow on its surface die, they don't fully decay but accumulate in layers.
sentences.zh: 泥炭沼泽含水量高达90%；其土壤饱含水分，以致于生长在沼泽表面的草类与石楠死亡后无法完全腐烂，而是层层堆积起来。

sentences.en: Objects remain so well preserved in these conditions because of the acidity of the peat and the deficiency of oxygen.
sentences.zh: 在这种环境下，各类物品之所以能如此完好地保存下来，是因为泥炭具有强酸性且缺氧。

sentences.en: At least 175 days of rain a year are required for this to happen; this part of Ireland gets an average of 225 days.
sentences.zh: 要形成这种环境，每年至少需要175天的降雨量；而爱尔兰这一地区年均降雨天数达225天。

sentences.en: The Neolithic farmers at Céide would have enjoyed several centuries of relative peace and stability.
sentences.zh: 凯德的新石器时代农民曾享有数个世纪相对和平与稳定的时期。

sentences.en: Neolithic farmers generally lived in larger communities than their predecessors, with a number of houses built around community building.
sentences.zh: 新石器时代的农民通常比其先辈居住在更大的社群中，多座房屋围绕着一处公共建筑而建。

sentences.en: As they lived in permanent settlements, Neolithic farmers were able to build bigger houses.
sentences.zh: 由于他们生活在永久性聚居地，新石器时代的农民得以建造更大的房屋。

sentences.en: These weren't round as people often assume, but rectangular with a small hole in the roof that allowed smoke to escape.
sentences.zh: 这些房屋并非人们通常所认为的圆形，而是矩形结构，屋顶上开有一个小孔，以便烟雾排出。

sentences.en: This is one of many innovations and indicates that the Neolithic farmers were the first people to cook indoors.
sentences.zh: 这是众多创新之一，表明新石器时代的农民是首批在室内烹饪的人群。

sentences.en: Another new technology that Neolithic settlers brought to Ireland was pottery.
sentences.zh: 新石器时代定居者带入爱尔兰的另一项新技术是陶器制作。

sentences.en: Fragments of Neolithic pots have been found in Céide and elsewhere in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 在凯德及爱尔兰其他地区均已发现新石器时代陶器的碎片。

sentences.en: The pots were used for many things; as well as for storing food, pots were filled with small amount of fat and when this was set alight, they served as lamps.
sentences.zh: 这些陶器用途广泛：除用于储存食物外，人们还会在陶罐中注入少量脂肪，点燃后便可用作照明灯具。

sentences.en: It's thought that the Céide Fields were mainly used as paddocks for animals to graze in.
sentences.zh: 据推测，凯德田野主要被用作牲畜放牧的围场。

sentences.en: Evidence from the Céide Fields suggests that each plot of land was of a suitable size to sustain an extended family.
sentences.zh: 凯德田野出土的证据表明，每一块土地的面积都足以供养一个扩展家庭。

sentences.en: They may have used a system of rotational grazing in order to prevent over-grazing and to allow for plant recovery and regrowth.
sentences.zh: 他们可能采用了轮牧制度，以防止过度放牧，并促进植被恢复与再生。

sentences.en: This must have been a year-round activity as no structures have been found which would have been used to shelter animals in the winter.
sentences.zh: 这必定是一项全年无休的活动，因为迄今尚未发现任何可供牲畜冬季避寒的建筑结构。

sentences.en: However, archaeologists believe that this way of life at Céide ceased abruptly.
sentences.zh: 然而，考古学家认为，凯德这种生活方式曾突然中断。

sentences.en: Why was this?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, several factors may have contributed to the changing circumstances.
sentences.zh: 事实上，多种因素可能共同导致了这一状况的改变。

sentences.en: The soil would have become less productive and led to the abandonment of farming.
sentences.zh: 土壤肥力逐渐下降，最终致使农耕活动被废弃。

sentences.en: The crop rotation system was partly responsible for this as it would have been very intensive and was not sustainable.
sentences.zh: 轮作制度部分导致了这一结果，因其耕作强度极大，难以持续。

sentences.en: But there were also climatic pressures too.
sentences.zh: 此外，气候压力也起到了作用。

sentences.en: The farmers at Céide would have enjoyed a relatively dry period, but this began to change and the conditions became wetter as there was a lot more rain.
sentences.zh: 凯德的农民原本享受着一段相对干燥的时期，但此后气候开始转变，降雨显著增多，环境变得愈发潮湿。

sentences.en: It was these conditions that encouraged the bog to form over the area which survives today.
sentences.zh: 正是这种潮湿条件促使泥炭沼泽在此区域形成，并延续至今。

sentences.en: So now I'd like to show you some . . .
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向大家展示一些……
